crossRefs.note: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
“Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due…
The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them…
He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the…
He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

translations.web: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
translations.bsb: A king delights in a wise servant, but his anger falls on the shameful.
translations.kjv: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
translations.asv: The king's favor is toward a servant that dealeth wisely; But his wrath will be against him that causeth shame.
